title: Scooby-Doo! Mystery Mayhem
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Shaggy and Scooby; courage meter
Shaggy (with Scooby) explores, collects clues and traps ghosts with the Tome of Doom
Courage drops when scared; Scooby Snacks restore it

rows: capture ghosts back into the book

widgets.text:
The Tome of Doom sucks monsters back into its pages: aim it and hold until the ghost is captured
Clues found in each area solve the episode's mystery

Use the book to trap ghosts
Every episode ends in a boss fight against the episode's monster
Episodes also have a "ride" chase section before the boss
Weaken ghosts first, then capture them with the book

Episodes with mysteries
5 episodes (from the ROM's level list):

rows: campus, basement, library (3 parts), archives (3 parts)
castle, catacombs, joust, graveyard and crypt, statue room
research center, elevator, lower level, secret lab

widgets.text:
Scooby Snacks, clues
Scooby Snacks heal courage; clues are kept per episode

Clues per episode
Clues per episode; finish an episode with all clues for the full solution

Episodes solved
5 episodes in order; each unlocks the next
Each episode has a ride section and a boss fight
